extracted.intended_audience: BuzzFeed editorial staff, contributors, and the general readership
extracted.subtask_description: Organization-level editorial and ethics guidelines for producing BuzzFeed content across news, entertainment, lifestyle, shopping, and AI-enhanced formats, describing sourcing, corrections, AI use, disclosure, and inclusion practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver stories that are engaging, informative, and fun; mix trending news with entertainment and retail therapy while remaining accessible and inclusive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connect readers to the world in a meaningful and enjoyable way; produce reader-first stories that matter; emphasize trust, accessibility, inclusivity, and representing the audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sourcing Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Every BuzzFeed article is edited to make sure it’s properly sourced and compliant with our style guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gather information from credible sources such as experts, research studies, official statements, and firsthand accounts; editors vet content to ensure accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections Process
rubrics_metrics.description: If we get something wrong, we’re all about transparency; BuzzFeed has a clear corrections policy to keep you in the loop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Update any errors, explain what changed, and ensure readers are seeing the most accurate version; make changes quickly when new information or breaking news emerges and communicate updates to readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of AI in Content Creation
rubrics_metrics.description: AI is a tool to spark ideas, assist with creative tasks, and explore formats; it is not a replacement for the editorial team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review and verify AI-generated content to ensure accuracy and alignment with BuzzFeed’s mission; editors double-check AI outputs because AI can make mistakes; AI should enhance creativity while meeting editorial standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Our editorial team operates independently of any advertisers or sponsors; content is free from external influence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure ethical journalism practices (e.g., 'we don't punch down'); maintain opinion independence from outside interests so content resonates with authenticity and integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising and Affiliate Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsored content and affiliate links will be clearly marked so readers know what’s paid content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a clear distinction between editorial and shopping/affiliate teams; sponsored or affiliate arrangements should never impact editorial decisions; disclose affiliate links and note potential small commissions from purchases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Commitment to inclusive journalism that represents a wide range of voices, perspectives, and experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive to avoid bias and highlight voices that might not be heard in mainstream media; editorial teams should actively work to produce content that reflects equity, diversity, and inclusion across brands and coverage areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: User-Generated Content and Comment Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain community guidelines to keep conversations respectful and welcoming; moderate comments to ensure discussions stay friendly and fun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage reader participation (comments, ideas, feedback) while enforcing rules that require respect for others; use moderation to foster a positive environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact & Feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide channels for readers to report inaccuracies, give feedback, or ask questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage readers to contact feedback@buzzfeed.com with errors or suggestions; treat reader input as a tool to maintain and improve editorial standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to Readers
rubrics_metrics.description: A pledge to spread truth and joy through high-quality, entertaining, and responsible content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to editorial standards and responsible AI use to deliver content that is trustworthy, meaningful, enjoyable, and worth sharing; value reader trust and engagement.
